notes.title: Hentai MineSweeper - Endless Mode has been released!!!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/968880]Hentai MineSweeper - Endless Mode[/url] has been released!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/968880

You can set your favorite subreddit(s) as the source of the images and play the game all the time!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33676293/205fa16536539a872c6464ebac80f775a27de3ce.png[/img]

Some exciting subreddits:
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ecchi/]ecchi[/url][/b] - "Ecchi, NSFW pictures of anime characters."
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/hentai/]hentai[/url][/b] - "Hentai is a genre of pornography with Anime or Manga styling."
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pantsu/]pantsu[/url][/b] - "For fanservicey art from manga, anime, VNs, JRPGs, etc."
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/MoeMorphism/]MoeMorphism[/url][/b] - "Turning the inanimate into moe."
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/awwnime/]awwnime[/url][/b] - "For all kinds of moe art. Especially cute anime girls and boys being cute. Strictly SFW, with named sources. Content from anime, manga, visual novels, JRPGs, Vocaloids, Touhou, etc, and original works. "

You can also combine multiple subreddits, for example:
[b][url=https://www.reddit.com/r/awwnime+hentai/]awwnime+hentai[/url][/b] - Combine [b]awwnime[/b] subreddit and [b]hentai[/b] subreddit!
